name: 22711-imagereuse-qwen25vl3b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine, served in-process through guidellm's vllm_python backend.
architecture: vision-language decoder, Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, 3.75B params (~7.5 GB bf16); the rest is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup 30%, no cooldown, bound at 1000 requests with a 900 s safety cap, seed static 22711. The bound is the whole request file exactly once and must not exceed its 1000 rows, because guidellm stops when a finite dataset is exhausted rather than looping.
workload: a LOCAL request file, `configs/data/visionarena-reuse.parquet`, 1000 rows, each one single-turn request: one JPEG, one question about it, and `output_tokens_count: 128` (the backend turns that into max_tokens=128 with ignore_eos, so every response is exactly 128 tokens). The file holds 500 distinct images, each appearing in two adjacent rows carrying two different questions about it; rows 2i and 2i+1 are the pair. It must be consumed in file order and exactly once -- the structure is positional, so shuffling the loader destroys it, and a synthetic image generator cannot stand in for it. The images are real photographs from lmarena-ai/VisionArena-Chat, longest edge at most 1024 px (median 82 KB, median 647 image tokens, max 1369); the questions are the users' own text, median 35 characters. `configs/data/make-dataset.py` regenerates the file deterministically and `configs/data/dataset-manifest.tsv` lists the conversation id, digest and pixel size behind every image.
purpose: A photo question-answering assistant on a 3B vision-language model, 32 concurrent users asking paired questions per image, one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's launch configuration. Every key is written out and pinned explicitly rather
# than inherited, so a change of engine default cannot move it.

model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 8192
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
enable-prefix-caching: false
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
